purpose: Inventory memory, database, retrieval, MCP, and skill capabilities that historically lived under Atramenti-Console so they can be integrated into the DataBase ecosystem without reviving retired local source paths.

extractionPolicy.reason: Atramenti-Console is an application/control-surface repository. Its Windows checkout was cleaned, pushed, and retired on 2026-05-11; forward capability ownership now belongs to DataBase services, dedicated capability repositories, or the global Codex control plane.

capabilities.role: Unified memory MCP surface for durable experience records and QMD-backed retrieval.
capabilities.dataTruth: cloud MySQL tables plus QMD mirror
capabilities.migrationAction: Use the sanitized DataBase internal service as the forward memory MCP surface. Do not import Atramenti frontend or historical knowledge bundle until reviewed.

capabilities.role: Local markdown search, BM25/vector retrieval, and experience-manager mirror index.
capabilities.migrationAction: Treat current Atramenti path as historical cleanstream source. Use my-project-qmd as the preferred forward source of truth.

capabilities.role: Canonical MCP entrypoint for database inspection and operational context.

targetOwnership.sourceCode: DataBase/services/database-ops-mcp or dedicated database capability repo

capabilities.migrationAction: Use the DataBase-owned service path or dedicated capability repository. Do not restore the retired Atramenti local checkout as the source path.

capabilities.role: Product/business API surface for controlled database resources.
capabilities.migrationAction: Keep separate from database-ops-mcp; DataBase records contracts and access policy only.

capabilities.role: Plan ledger recall, append, and optional sync into experience-manager.

targetOwnership.sourceCode: global Codex skills root or dedicated skills repository

capabilities.migrationAction: Extract policy and ingestion semantics into DataBase; keep executable skill source under the global Codex skills root or a normalized skills repository.

capabilities.role: Historical/reference design for lifecycle scoring, auto recall, and memory policy.
capabilities.migrationAction: Do not restore as live MCP. Preserve useful policy ideas in DataBase memory architecture docs.

riskRegister.finding: Default database connection values include credential-shaped material in source.
riskRegister.policy: Move credentials to environment or secret surface; DataBase may record the secret surface path but must not store the secret value.

riskRegister.finding: Local worktree was previously dirty and divergent; it was cleaned, pushed, and prepared for local deletion on 2026-05-11.
riskRegister.policy: Do not use E:\My Project\Atramenti-Console as a future capability source. Use GitHub, the remote IDE workspace, DataBase services, dedicated capability repositories, or C:\Users\ASUS-KL\.codex for Codex runtime assets.

targetArchitecture.memoryTruth: DataBase records memory schema, topology, and ingestion policy.
targetArchitecture.retrieval: QMD remains the fast local retrieval layer; future vector storage can add Onyx/LanceDB without replacing DataBase truth.
targetArchitecture.runtime: Mortis consumes memory through a stable MCP/API surface, not direct ad-hoc file paths.
targetArchitecture.governance: ContractGuard checks each repository project.json and prevents mirror/legacy/source drift.
